en.headline: Four more patients carry Candida auris at Wong Tai Sin Hospital
en.dek: The hospital said the four men aged 44 to 72 showed no symptoms and were isolated after contact tracing in the same ward.
body: Tung Wah Group of Hospitals Wong Tai Sin Hospital said on Thursday that contact tracing had identified four more male patients in the same care ward carrying Candida auris.
The men, aged between 44 and 72, had no infection symptoms and were receiving isolation treatment, with their conditions stable, a hospital spokesman said.
The hospital has stepped up screening, contact precautions and thorough cleaning of the ward, and has reported the cases to the Hospital Authority and the Centre for Health Protection.

zh.headline: 黃大仙醫院再多4名男病人帶有耳念珠菌
zh.dek: 院方經接觸追蹤在同一護養病房發現4名44至72歲男病人帶菌，均無病徵，正接受隔離，情況穩定。
body: 東華三院黃大仙醫院今日公布，就早前護養病房耳念珠菌個案，經接觸追蹤再發現同一病房多四名男病人帶有耳念珠菌。
有關病人年齡由44歲至72歲，目前並無感染病徵，正接受隔離治療，情況穩定。
院方已加強病人及環境篩查、嚴格執行接觸傳播防護措施及徹底清潔消毒相關病房，並將個案呈報醫院管理局及衞生署衞生防護中心。
